text:
tara: quick async scrub — final-mile capacity check for the 4-rack dedicated pod. doing a fast pass on open blockers, ownership, and any last-minute reservation deltas. ping owners below.

ben: +1. can we call out network/cabling and power separately? those have the tightest lead times.

sophia: network/cabling is blocked on the vendor ETA — they said week of 3/22 but not firm. i've got an updated PO number: PO-92431.

mike: power is scheduled with DC ops for 3/25 0200-0400 PT. circuit crew needs the final rack manifest by EOD tomorrow.

tara: thanks. owners: racks = @ben, cabling = @sophia, power coord = @mike, reservation reconcile = @kevin, canary plan = @lia. if anyone is not owner, call it out.

kevin: I have reservation reconciliation. current delta: we reserved 64 GPUs, manifest shows 68 arriving. need confirmation if 4 are spare buys or mis-ship. opened ticket with procurement (PR-5512).

ben: i'll validate physical assignment tomorrow morning. if 4 extra, we can either add to staging pool or mark for swap with other customer.

lia: canary plan note — prefer to run a small traffic slice on dedicated cap first 24h, then expand. need routing config and fallback rules.

tara: quick asks for owners before EOD: 1) final rack manifest (ben) 2) cabling ETA confirmation (sophia) 3) power window confirmed in the change (mike) 4) reservation delta resolution (kevin) 5) canary runbook + abort criteria (lia).

sophia: vendor replied: tentative ship 3/24, courier consolidator might push to 3/26 if customs hold. i'm escalating.

mike: DC ops confirmed change window, but they require final rack U-numbering in this format:

```
rack-01: nodes 1-8
rack-02: nodes 1-8
rack-03: nodes 1-8
rack-04: nodes 1-8
```

please fill and DM to me.

kevin: procurement confirmed PR-5512 — those 4 are extra spares from the order (not mis-ship). decision: do we want to accept spares into staging? tallying cost vs. storage.

ben: accept spares into staging for now. will tag them 'spare-qa' and record serials.

lia: working on canary runbook, rough steps below — will push to docs repo when done:
- carve out 5% traffic to pod
- keep model size constrained (<= 2k seq)
- monitor p95 latency and error-rate
- automatic rollback if p95 > 2.5x baseline or error > 1%

tara: perfect. two more items: 1) is the KV cache warmup plan ready? 2) any infra code review blocking the rollout?

mike: KV warmup script is in the repo, but needs owner approval from infra team. @ben can you review the PR (#221)?

ben: will review PR #221 tonight. quick note: I saw a small race in startup ordering — i'll annotate.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: infra PRs: 1 open (PR #221), k8s manifests: 4 changed, smoke tests: not run.

kevin: procurement will log the spare serials under manifest ID MF-7819. i'll also update reservation to +4 spare.

tara: timeline check — if cabling slips to 3/26 we'll likely push power window to 3/27. is that acceptable?

mike: DC ops prefers not to move beyond 3/27. beyond that they slot other customers. so slack is fine but need firm by 3/24 EOD.

lia: also need confirmation of rollout throttle in the routing policy: currently set to 5 qps per node; may need to adjust for latency heat.

ben: noted. i'll run quick perf on a reserve node and post numbers.

sophia: vendor reconfirmed customs hold is unlikely; i have flight tracking for the shipment and will post updates.

tara: owners, can we get the items acknowledged here? i'll compile into the handoff doc after: final manifest, cable ETA, power window, spare acceptance, PR review, canary runbook.

ben: ack — final manifest tomorrow AM.

sophia: ack — will update courier ETAs in this thread.

mike: ack — power window locked if manifest in by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: ack — spares accepted, updating reservation.

lia: ack — runbook v0 pushed to docs tomorrow.

tara: awesome. i'll post the final handoff by 10am PDT. if any surprises ping me directly. :thumbsup:

mike: small FYI — DC ops asked for a contact number for the on-site engineer. DMing Tara now.

kevin: PR #221 review comment: minor ordering fix, not blocking.

ben: posted perf numbers: p95 local load = 48ms, p99 = 120ms (2k seq). sharing logs in the bench channel.

tara: thanks team. closing this async scrub — will follow up with the handoff doc and action items.

lia: :rocket:

infra-bot: reminder scheduled — run smoke tests after canary start.
